title: FastFlags preset library + editor UI
rationale: Strategic relevance: match. Competitors with this feature: https://github.com/AppleBlox/appleblox (preset expansion), https://github.com/pizzaboxer/bloxstrap (Fast Flag editor). Substrate already existed (ClientSettingsWriter, setFFlags); shipped curated preset library (Low-resource + new Performance bundle) + arbitrary key/value editor with risky-flag caution badges. Approach A: activePreset + overrides, dedicated stacked sheet. Cart-detection: light flow, build ran through vibe-cartographer /build against the superpowers implementation plan. Total :rate score: 21/25. Smoke-tested: preset selection/persistence/write all clean (13 flags, createdFresh); PerformanceFFlags runtime bench deferred per ADR 0011.

title: Framerate-overrides: warn-pill badge + honest Settings copy when override diverges from global
rationale: User-trust tier: breaks-trust (Settings copy was actively false — 'every running instance is throttled at this rate uniformly' the moment any account had an override) + erodes-trust (override badge existed but was invisible: mono-micro white-0.85 inside a cyan gradient launch button). Surface: SettingsView Frame rate section + AccountsListView per-row badge in splitLaunchButton. Five rough patches found in the focused scan; bundled top two (copy fix + warn-pill render) as one polish since they form the same trap's two surfaces. Cart-detection: light flow — own muscle for the 4-task plan; superpowers brainstorming + writing-plans + subagent-driven-development per task with two-stage review (spec compliance + code quality) gates; finishing-a-development-branch for PR. Worktree-isolated execution. NOTE: this branch is off origin/main and contains a fresh atlas.jsonl with only this entry; the FFlag PR (#2) carries the FFlag competitive entry separately. Merge order is independent — both will need a small concat-resolve when both land on main.

Per-account chevron menu rename to 'Frame rate cap override (this account)' (queued, trust=1, names the relationship)
Launch-time transient signal when effective cap ≠ global (queued, trust=3, heaviest — new UI surface)

title: Fix: chord kill-key tolerates stray modifiers
rationale: Severity major, frequency high, blast-radius most-users (priority 12/15). Repro: configured chord (Ctrl+Opt+Shift+P) + event with stray Cmd silently dropped to .userEngaged instead of firing .killRequested — exact-equality modifier match rejected the chord. Fix: two-mode policy in matchesKillCombo — bare-key (configured mods == 0) keeps exact equality (defensive); chord (configured mods >= 1) uses subset match (configured mods required, extras allowed). Three regression tests added under new 'Modifier-match policy' section; 15/15 AutoKeysSafetyMonitorTests + 12/12 AutoKeysCyclerTests pass. Pre-existing keychain-test teardown crashes (SIGILL on tempPath nil-unwrap) surfaced incidentally and flagged in feedback.md as separate bug-bash candidate — untouched by this fix.
